workflow_rules.text: Do not use `tmux attach-session -d` in the Codex Haven/WebTTY entry scripts. `-d` detaches other clients, so Haven SSH and `19899`/`19900` WebTTY cannot stay realtime-synced on the same tmux pane. Use plain `tmux attach-session -t "$SESSION"` for `haven-entry-codex{,2}` and `ttyd-codex{,2}-entry`.

Do not debug Codex WebTTY input failures on `19899`/`19900`/`19901` by repeatedly guessing ttyd/xterm causes, restarting ttyd first, or doing broad web searches.
